text: A muscular male figure, likely adult, with dark skin and short, matted brown hair. His face is broad with a grimace, showing teeth. He wears minimal black loincloth. He strides forward aggressively, right arm raised in a fist, left hand gripping a spear. Behind him, four smaller figures follow similarly armed. All appear to be running uphill on rocky terrain under a purple-tinged sky. The lead figure’s pose suggests imminent attack or charge.
